name: PerfMon
tagline: Windows 11 Task Manager & Precision Telemetry Suite
short_description: A native macOS system monitor with selectable desktop widget previews, eight graph styles, optional adaptive network scaling, process monitoring, disk and network topology, startup item management, and a custom menu bar builder.
spotlight_description: PerfMon 1.5.3 adds automatic Dock icon removal when the main window is closed while keeping the Menu Bar item and Desktop Widgets active, and restores the running process window from the Menu Bar, double-clicking or right-clicking any widget, or reopening the app.
